architecture_updates.adopted_approach: Add PLS-GR-01/0.1.0 with one resolve(request) entrypoint and nine typed stages: classify, infer intent, choose strategy, bind semantic references, apply tolerance policy, evaluate, validate, heal and commit. Every stage is evidence-bearing and may explicitly hold/fail; evaluation remains isolated; topology correspondence is rebuilt before commit; only commit may propose a PLS-KERNEL-01 world transaction.
consequences: The geometry layer becomes testable stage-by-stage instead of only through end-state solids.
AI can reason about and inspect geometry failures without owning geometry truth or guessing from opaque kernel exceptions.
OpenCascade strategies can be improved or replaced locally while PLS-GR-01 remains stable.
Concurrent/background exact evaluation can remain safe because commit is revision-pinned and atomic.
Resolver traces become reusable evidence for regression testing, debugging and future strategy learning.
critical_rules: No accepted world mutation occurs before commit.
Provider handles are ephemeral binding results, never canonical input identity.
Tolerance and healing are explicit policy envelopes, not hidden kernel defaults.
Validation checks semantic postconditions as well as geometric validity.
Healing is bounded, evidence-bearing and cannot alter design intent.
Stale candidate results cannot be replayed onto a newer world without re-resolution.
Approximate preview artifacts are never silently promoted to exact commit geometry.
Stable public error codes remain provider-neutral; raw provider errors are nested diagnostics.
architecture_updates.previous_approach: PLS-17 named the resolver stages and policies but did not yet define stable request/result envelopes, stage signatures, error semantics, replay pins, provider adapter boundaries or atomic commit preconditions.
architecture_updates.source_context: The canonical geometry-verb architecture required a concrete API boundary so humans, AI, direct manipulation and future geometry providers can all execute through the same deterministic resolution path rather than accumulating bespoke kernel calls.
architecture_updates.title: Define PLS-GR-01 as the staged Plasma Geometry Resolver API

architecture_updates.adopted_approach: Split the model into contextual interaction verbs above a small canonical geometry vocabulary. Route all exact geometry through a Plasma Geometry Resolver that classifies geometry, resolves intent, selects strategy/provider, binds semantic references, applies bounded tolerance policy, evaluates, validates, heals/simplifies, reconstructs topology correspondence and only then permits atomic commit. Treat CONNECT/Junction as a persistent semantic Relation whose geometric realization may compose multiple canonical verbs. Keep OpenCascade as the initial exact executor beneath this contract.
consequences: PLS-17 becomes a more stable geometry language that can survive kernel replacement or selective multi-provider routing.
Architectural junctions, hosted openings and fabrication connections can retain intent across geometric regeneration.
OpenCascade weaknesses become bounded engineering problems in specific strategy classes rather than reasons to contaminate the world model or abandon the kernel prematurely.
Direct manipulation can remain fluid by separating fast preview representations from exact validated commit and limiting recomputation to the affected region.
Geometry quality becomes testable through explicit cleanliness invariants and regression fixtures instead of subjective downstream cleanup.
critical_rules: User-facing commands and architectural tools compile to canonical geometry verbs; they do not become kernel primitives.
Non-destructive operation history is the default; current B-Rep is an evaluated exact representation, not the sole design record.
Semantic topology references outrank raw face/edge numbering and provider handles.
Numerical, snap, construction, fabrication, import and display tolerances remain distinct concepts.
Approximate interactive preview may precede exact evaluation, but commit-critical geometry cannot silently downgrade fidelity.
Invalid, dirty, ambiguously rebound or tolerance-exploded exact geometry is held/rejected with diagnostics rather than silently accepted.
Do not fork OCCT wholesale before repeated failure classes are isolated by a deterministic pathology corpus.
architecture_updates.previous_approach: PLS-17 already compiled simple interaction verbs into provider-neutral OperationPlans and prohibited provider topology handles from becoming canonical identity, but the verb set mixed UI actions with geometry semantics and did not fully define resolver strategy, junction meaning, tolerance separation, clean-geometry commit invariants or an OCCT-specific hardening policy.
architecture_updates.source_context: Review of standard CAD interactions—extend, trim, split, junction and non-destructive Boolean—identified that provider-neutrality alone is insufficient. Plasma also needs stable operation semantics, tolerance/reference policy, junction relationships, exact-result validation and a disciplined hardening boundary around OpenCascade.
architecture_updates.title: Adopt canonical geometry verbs and a governed Geometry Resolver over OpenCascade

architecture_updates.adopted_approach: Add PLS-17 for the spatial operation/compiler and kernel-neutral geometry/fabrication provider layer; add PLS-18 for append-only knowledge, supersession, source updates, KnowledgeUseTrace and project baselines. Strengthen PLS-09 with a revision-pinned Representation Request/Response protocol, PLS-10 with interaction-representation/exact-catch-up semantics, PLS-14 with a small cross-modal spatial verb set, and PLS-KERNEL-01 with provider-neutrality, representation-honesty and temporal-knowledge invariants. Keep the seven kernel primitives and existing BEGIN→…→EMIT transaction lifecycle unchanged.
consequences: OpenCascade can remain the economical initial exact provider while the architecture preserves a clean future path to ACIS/Parasolid or other kernels.
Three.js remains free to optimize selection, display and proxy interaction without becoming the source of exact geometry truth.
Natural-language shortcuts and direct manipulation use one typed operation path, reducing AI-specific mutation logic.
Representation failure becomes inspectable and recoverable; it no longer forces global freezes or silent fidelity downgrades.
Historical projects can remain reproducible on older applicable knowledge baselines while newer work adopts updated sources.
Fabrication feedback can enrich Plasma knowledge and constraints while tool-specific manufacturing detail remains in specialist software where appropriate.
architecture_updates.previous_approach: PLS-KERNEL-01 already forbade external engines from owning canonical truth, PLS-09 separated representations, PLS-10 bounded recomputation and PLS-14 defined adaptive interaction. However, the spec lacked a concrete spatial-verb compiler, provider capability/router contract, topology identity boundary, explicit representation-failure semantics, specialist fabrication ownership map, durable general Knowledge Ledger and project baseline pins.
rejected_or_constrained_claims: Do not treat Three.js as an exact CAD kernel; use it initially for interactive/render representations behind the same neutral request boundary.
Do not make OpenCascade, ACIS, Parasolid, IFC or any provider topology handle part of canonical Plasma identity.
Do not promise that AI will make OpenCascade universally equivalent to mature proprietary kernels; specialize/harden the domain and retain the ability to route or swap providers.
Do not require Plasma to replace Fusion, Inventor, SolidWorks or CAM depth before it can own cross-domain design intent and world state.
Do not put general industry knowledge directly into project state or rely on model weights as the auditable source of record.
Do not apply a newly accepted code/standard/vendor version to every existing project automatically.
architecture_updates.source_context: Morning review of MoI, Bonzai3D, Bonsai/IfcOpenShell and specialist fabrication CAD highlighted a common separation: quiet direct manipulation can sit above deep exact geometry; semantic/project state need not be owned by the geometry engine; and specialist manufacturing systems can remain peers rather than targets for immediate replacement. Follow-on discussion identified a separate versioned knowledge bank and the need to keep older projects pinned to historically applicable rules.
architecture_updates.title: Adopt simple spatial verbs over kernel-neutral geometry providers and versioned project knowledge baselines

architecture_updates.adopted_approach: Keep PLS-KERNEL-01 unchanged. Treat semantic/relation, dependency/invalidation, evidence/provenance and execution/work graphs as revision-pinned projections over one authoritative seven-primitives world. Add PLS-15 Work Orchestration + Execution Graph Runtime to define durable WorkItems, versioned ExecutionPlans, dynamic dependency discovery, cycle/SCC solve units, context capsules, resource/latency scheduling, restart/resume, idempotent publication and side-effect classes. Reuse PLS-10 as the bounded low-latency execution substrate.
consequences: PLS-10 remains valid and becomes the executor/substrate for interactive and bounded work rather than being replaced.
Context engineering becomes a deterministic/runtime product: WorkItems receive minimal revision-pinned context capsules assembled from world/dependency/evidence state.
Overnight and multi-alternative design can become crash-resumable, observable and selectively reusable instead of one opaque agent loop.
Dynamic dependencies and SCC detection become explicit correctness requirements for topology/rule/solver changes.
External/physical actions gain stronger idempotency, authority and reconciliation semantics than pure computation.
Future stronger AI can replace or collapse WorkItems without migrating Plasma world identity, evidence or publication authority into model weights.
architecture_updates.previous_approach: PLS-10 handled bounded local/regional propagation and retained an execution DAG inheritance, but long-running work was not represented by one general durable WorkItem/ExecutionPlan contract. Earlier analysis risked elevating WorldGraph, CausalGraph and EvidenceGraph into parallel architectural systems.
rejected_or_constrained_claims: Do not make Graph an eighth kernel primitive.
Do not equate dependency edges with causal truth.
Do not require the architectural world to be stored primarily as a graph database.
Do not assume all execution is a DAG; architectural feedback systems require explicit cycle/solve semantics.
Do not build an agent graph for work that deterministic functions, solvers, humans or direct manipulation can execute more reliably.
Do not allow successful task execution to self-promote its output into accepted project state.
architecture_updates.source_context: A graph-engineering progression (prompt → context → loop → graph) was red-teamed against Plasma/Foundry v0.4.21. The current spec already contained semantic dependencies, dirty frontiers, execution DAGs, bounded reactivity, currentness, evidence lineage and CPU/GPU scheduling, so introducing separate authoritative World/Causal/Evidence/Work graph systems would duplicate or weaken existing boundaries.
architecture_updates.title: Adopt graph engineering as derived projection + durable work orchestration, not a new Plasma ontology

architecture_updates.adopted_approach: Add PLS-14 Adaptive Interaction Lens Runtime. Distinguish Representation Lens (what is shown), Interaction Lens (what actions are surfaced and how) and Evaluation Lens (what consequences/checks matter now). Resolve their composition through task/selection/dependency-aware semantic relevance. Project typed dependency edges as optional relationship bonds and PLS-10 speculative/currentness state as an honest blast-radius preview. Keep an explicit Inspect/Neutral mode and hierarchy projection. Govern adaptive or generated UI/capabilities through propose → test-first contract → sandbox → guided human validation → affected-world replay → exact-digest acceptance → versioned promotion/rollback.
consequences: PLS-09 View Contracts remain the representation substrate but no longer need to carry interaction/evaluation semantics.
PLS-13 reasoning lenses remain epistemic/question/criteria context; PLS-14 evaluation lenses may invoke them but are distinct.
PLS-10 Dirty Frontier, Dependency Horizon and Consistency Horizon become directly legible through UI preview/blast-radius state.
FND-04/ADK capability development gains a user-facing validation path without becoming a runtime prerequisite.
Personal/team/client interfaces can diverge as versioned lens configurations while sharing one authoritative world.
Minimalism is treated as a relevance problem, not a command-hiding problem.
architecture_updates.previous_approach: Plasma separately specified contextual representation (PLS-09), bounded speculative/direct-manipulation runtime behavior (PLS-10), reasoning lenses (PLS-13) and reflexive capability development (FND-04), but lacked a unified interaction-layer contract for composing these into a low-clutter yet inspectable professional UI.
rejected_or_constrained_claims: A cloud geometry kernel is not foundational; local/hybrid execution remains valid and often preferred for interaction latency/resilience.
A feature/object tree is not abolished; it becomes an inspectable projection rather than the primary workflow.
UI personalization cannot silently mutate professional interaction semantics.
Generated tests do not prove physical/regulatory completeness.
Co-evolution of app and content does not eliminate technical debt; it increases the need for versioning, migration, provenance and deprecation discipline.
architecture_updates.source_context: Prompt-derived design exploration in “Minimalist Next-Gen CAD UI Design” proposed progressive disclosure, spatial constraint bonds, predictive downstream previews, semantic depth/history, AI-generated capabilities with preflight tests, adaptable user-specific interfaces and multiple data lenses. Plasma adopts the underlying interaction principles selectively rather than the document’s stronger claims.
architecture_updates.title: Interaction lenses, semantic relevance and governed adaptive UI become first-class Plasma runtime concepts

architecture_updates.adopted_approach: Integrate RC-02 semantics directly into the existing bedroom direct-manipulation subsystem. Derive the hard boundary from the current world and hard rule rather than fixture constants; allow the pointer to cross that boundary; retain the full requested geometry as a conflicted local speculative preview; show the hard-limit line, excess region, corridor deficit and currentness; expose exact-hard-limit, preserve-corridor and return-to-current actions; submit only non-hard-blocked candidates through the existing proposal path; and keep AI outside the pointer loop.
consequences: The interaction now demonstrates the architectural rule that constraints gate publication rather than exploration on the real Plasma bedroom editor path.
The UI can preserve user intent beyond a hard boundary without silently clamping, silently breaking the rule or forcing a model decision.
Hard-limit values must be derived from authoritative current geometry/rules; synthetic fixture numbers must never leak into live-world explanations.
The next proof gate shifts from architecture design to normal-origin persistence/commit and physical desktop/iPhone measurement.
evidence: The actual direct bedroom PointerEvent handler was exercised through a headless Chromium DevTools harness rather than by mutating input values directly.

The live townhouse fixture resolves bedroom width 3500 mm, corridor clear 1150 mm and hard corridor target 1000 mm, producing an exact single-wall hard limit of +150 mm; the +315 mm number remains synthetic RC-02 fixture data only.

A +500 mm take-mode drag retains a 4000 mm bedroom conflicted preview, computes 650 mm corridor clear and a 350 mm deficit, and displays the hard-limit/excess overlay without publishing the invalid candidate.

The exact-hard-limit action produces +150 mm / 3650 mm bedroom width / 1000 mm corridor clear with no hard block; preserve-corridor produces +500 mm / 4000 mm bedroom width / 1150 mm corridor clear with no hard block.

Across 20 desktop-layout runs, preview timing measured p50 1.9 ms and p95 2.3 ms; release-to-checked measured p50 5.0 ms and p95 6.8 ms. Across 20 mobile-layout viewport runs, preview measured p50 1.9 ms and p95 2.3 ms; release-to-checked measured p50 5.0 ms and p95 6.1 ms.

No Runtime.exceptionThrown events were recorded by the harness; WebGL context creation errors under setDocumentContent were recoverable renderer-environment output rather than edit-runtime exceptions.
evidence_limits: The 430×932 DPR 3 profile tests responsive browser layout only; it is not physical iPhone performance evidence.
Page.setDocumentContent has no normal storage origin, so proposal persistence and committed world revision were not measured in the headless integration harness.
Headless Chromium CPU timings cannot establish production desktop/device latency budgets or release proof.
Independent collector provenance remains absent; evidence is supporting/unverified.
architecture_updates.previous_approach: v0.4.15 proved the event-reduced RC-02 runtime in executable tests but the actual Plasma bedroom SVG/direct-tool interaction still used its older preview/submit path, so the architecture had not yet proved that conflict-preserving editing remained understandable and responsive in the real interaction surface.
architecture_updates.title: Wire RC-02 conflict-preserving edit semantics into the actual bedroom direct-manipulation UI

architecture_updates.adopted_approach: Implement a pure event reducer, append-only in-memory event store and deterministic RC-02 command runtime against the v0.4.14 contract. Preserve requested intent in speculative state, derive the local dirty frontier, evaluate the pinned hard corridor rule, generate typed alternatives, scope idempotency by session, reject stale async results, use compare-and-swap world-head commit, and keep hard-rule revision in a separate authority path.
consequences: The RC-02 interaction no longer depends on conceptual prose alone; a runnable reference implementation now constrains future UI/worker implementations.
Event replay becomes the reference correctness mechanism for session state; UI component state must remain a cache/projection rather than authority.
The coupled +500/+185 alternative intentionally remains preview-pending after the local corridor check passes because its larger dirty frontier has not converged.
Local passing tests are supporting evidence only: browser/device latency, persistence, worker scheduling, exact geometry, collaboration and independent proof remain open.
Do not freeze PLS-EDIT-API-01 as a general Plasma contract until RC-01 and RC-03 expose whether the same reducer/event semantics recur without domain leakage.
evidence: Strict TypeScript 5.8.3 compilation passes for contract + runtime.
Reducer replay reconstructs the committed world head/session state from the append-only event log.
Tests demonstrate stale-result rejection, same-command-id isolation across sessions, soft/hard separation and pending coupled-move commit blocking.
architecture_updates.previous_approach: v0.4.14 specified machine-consumable edit objects, commands, events and commit gates but still left open whether the contract could be implemented cleanly without hidden component state, race-prone async mutation or model dependence in direct manipulation.
architecture_updates.title: Implement RC-02 as an event-reduced edit runtime before UI integration

architecture_updates.adopted_approach: Publish a no-dependency TypeScript contract for the generic edit-session slice and bind the spec to it. Use one versioned event envelope; separate deterministic hot-path intent/preview work from asynchronous control-path work; tag all candidate work by session/candidate/sequence/world/producer; require idempotent commands and compare-and-swap commit; and reject stale async results instead of allowing them to mutate current state.
consequences: RC-02 implementation should start from the contract artifact rather than reverse-engineering types from the HTML prose.
UI components render/query edit state but do not become the authoritative owners of session, candidate, constraint or decision state.
Pointer motion can remain highly responsive while hard-gate currentness is explicit; a missing result disables commit rather than fabricating validity.
AI can generate alternatives or explanations through the same command/event identities but cannot self-promote a candidate or alter hard-rule authority.
The contract remains pre-1.0 and may be changed after RC-01/RC-03 replay; compatibility changes require fixtures and migration notes before wider adoption.
architecture_updates.previous_approach: v0.4.13 defined the correct runtime objects, scheduling and interaction behaviour, but an implementation agent could still invent incompatible object shapes, ad-hoc component state, ambiguous event identity or commit semantics while claiming to follow the same architecture.
reason: A direct-manipulation architecture is only real when its state transitions and race conditions have explicit machine-consumable contracts.
Compile-time types alone are insufficient, so the artifact includes a runtime structural schema registry while semantic invariants remain explicit gates.
The same contract must support human gesture, exact input and AI proposal actors without letting model execution become a pointer-loop dependency.
Separating event identity from UI component state makes replay, undo, provenance, testing, collaboration and stale-result rejection tractable.
Compare-and-swap against both world head and candidate identity prevents an apparently valid late commit from overwriting newer work.
architecture_updates.title: Materialize RC-02 direct manipulation as a versioned TypeScript and event contract

architecture_updates.adopted_approach: Define RC-02 as a real-time transaction over EditSession, EditIntent, SpeculativeRevision, DirtyFrontier, ConstraintBinding/Evaluation, LensInvocation, AlternativeSet, DecisionRecord, CurrentnessSnapshot and CommittedRevision. Let the user drag through a hard boundary in speculative preview, visibly mark the exact limit, preserve the requested intent, generate typed alternatives on release, and block only authoritative promotion while hard conflicts remain. Keep LLM/model calls outside the per-pointer-update dependency path.
consequences: Hard constraints can block commit without automatically blocking gesture continuation.
Speculative/conflicted state becomes a normal first-class interaction state with explicit visual language and lineage.
AI is additive to direct manipulation: it can explain, compare and propose coupled alternatives after conflict/release but cannot sit in the pointer loop or self-promote changes.
RC-02 implementation must instrument pointer feedback, local-hard currentness, alternative-ready, commit-ready and convergence latencies separately.
Constraint source/class/authority remain explicit; crossing a hard rule in preview never implies permission to weaken or ignore it.
architecture_updates.previous_approach: RC-02 specified the operator sequence and expected alternatives but did not define the runtime objects, pointer-loop responsibilities, conflict-crossing behaviour, commit authority or exact UI/currentness semantics needed to make the interaction feel like design rather than a reasoning workflow.
reason: Architectural design frequently requires deliberately crossing existing constraints to discover a better coupled move; a hard-clamped handle turns constraints into geometry prisons and destroys the user's original intent.
A speculative branch lets Plasma distinguish exploration from commitment, so freedom of manipulation does not require weakening governance or correctness.
The exact limiting boundary is more useful than generic failure: it enables deterministic partial alternatives such as the fixture's 315 mm single-wall move.
Direct manipulation must survive model unavailability and variable inference latency; deterministic local geometry and constraint evaluation therefore own the interaction loop.
Preserving the requested 500 mm intent alongside the 315 mm feasible alternative provides better training/evidence for future AI and prevents the system from silently redefining the user's goal.
architecture_updates.title: Let direct manipulation cross constraints in speculative state; block invalid publication rather than exploration

architecture_updates.adopted_approach: Turn terrain/driveway, bedroom movement and planning interpretation into versioned synthetic replay fixtures with pinned inputs, explicit lenses, operator-level assertions, deterministic rule/tool references, perturbations, forbidden behaviours, measurable trace criteria and a cross-case operator-retention gate.
consequences: PLS-13 implementation starts as a validation harness, not a broad reasoning engine.
Operators must survive schema-level cross-case comparison and consolidation before being frozen as stable contracts.
Private model chain-of-thought is excluded from acceptance; replay depends only on public typed artifacts and pinned deterministic/substantive references.
The three fixtures intentionally include uncertainty, coupled geometry and interpretive authority so the abstraction is tested against different failure modes.
No fixture number or synthetic rule is to be treated as a real regulatory requirement.
architecture_updates.previous_approach: PLS-13 named three validation cases and sketched operator sequences, but those examples were not strict enough to distinguish a reusable reasoning architecture from fluent AI narration or domain-specific orchestration.
reason: A vocabulary can appear general while hiding incompatible semantics in each domain; replayable typed assertions expose that failure early.

The most important property is not whether an AI can produce a plausible explanation, but whether public artefacts preserve evidence, uncertainty, tools, authority, alternatives and supersession correctly.
Cross-domain recurrence provides evidence that an operator deserves kernel-level stability; domain-specific procedure should remain in capabilities, rules and lenses.
An explicit failure rule allows Plasma to delete PLS-13 if typed ordinary events prove sufficient, preventing sunk-cost architecture.
architecture_updates.title: Prove reasoning primitives through replayable cross-domain fixtures before implementation spread

architecture_updates.adopted_approach: Introduce a deliberately small typed reasoning vocabulary—observe, interpret, infer, question, propose, challenge, compare, evaluate, perspective, test, decide and revise—plus lightweight contextual Reasoning Lenses. These operate over Plasma's epistemic world and existing deterministic machinery, producing public typed artefacts that can be inspected, cited, replayed and superseded. They do not store private chain-of-thought and do not become a second source of truth.
consequences: PLS-12 remains the epistemic-state/value-of-information foundation; new PLS-13 defines the operations that consume and produce those states.
Reasoning explanations should be reconstructed from typed public artefacts, inputs, tools and transitions rather than from model-generated causal stories.
Reasoning Lens becomes to semantic interrogation what View Contract is to graphical representation: contextual resolution over one authoritative object.
Human and AI actors use the same operator and proposal contracts; model capability may improve without migrating authoritative world semantics into model weights.
The abstraction must pass terrain/driveway, bedroom movement and planning interpretation before wider implementation; this guards against adding terminology without recurring structural value.
The embedded Pattern Book ID collision is corrected and new patterns document typed reasoning, lenses and inspectable reasoning traces.
architecture_updates.previous_approach: Plasma had strong typed world state, evidence/provenance, proposals, constraints and epistemic classes, but the transitions between observed, interpreted, inferred, questioned, proposed, evaluated and revised states were mostly implicit in domain loops or AI behaviour.
reason: Observation and interpretation must remain separable so errors and uncertainty can be located rather than hidden inside fluent AI conclusions.
Questions and unresolved information are valuable state; forcing every reasoning pass into an answer destroys value-of-information reasoning and encourages false precision.

Architectural objects are legitimately interrogated from different disciplinary and stakeholder perspectives, but those perspectives should not require duplicated geometry or a swarm of autonomous agents.

Increasingly capable AI reduces the value of hard-coded bespoke reasoning workflows, but increases the value of stable world identity, evidence, deterministic checks, authority, commitments and typed provenance.
A small reusable operator set can let AI compose richer reasoning while Plasma remains deterministic where determinism matters.
architecture_updates.title: Separate epistemic state from composable reasoning operations

architecture_updates.adopted_approach: Extend existing bedroom operations and durable proposal runtime into synthetic terrain, driveway and pad. Add direct handles, exact local levels, separate source/proposed surfaces, local tile cache and typed AI preview/proposals; retain architectural and unassessed-domain limitations.
consequences: Current interaction prototype is partial evidence for PLS-01 and PLS-10, not completion of their normative contracts.
Context ingestion can start from survey/manual inputs without requiring real-to-sim reconstruction; representation resolution does not require site acquisition.
Standalone evidence flags cannot certify a capability or release.
Latest epistemic and performance-boundary requirements are retained and remain future acceptance gates where not implemented.
architecture_updates.title: Deliver a bounded shared human/AI edit path before general runtime expansion

architecture_updates.adopted_approach: Register benresonance-star/PLASMA as an ancestor/reference implementation. Preserve and evaluate its proven lower-level mechanisms—identity, selectors, provenance, composition, transactions, Execution-IR/DAG concepts, OCCT/analysis/fabrication service boundaries, import, frames, reproducibility, tests and benchmarks—behind current Plasma contracts. Explicitly reject legacy assumptions that conflict with the epistemic world, intent, fields/solvers, contextual representation, morphology and bounded reactive runtime.
consequences: The legacy repository must not be described as the canonical Plasma implementation until a package-level migration audit establishes that relationship.
Current implementation planning should classify legacy packages as reuse, wrap, refactor, split, replace or abandon based on code inspection and tests.
Generalized Plasma Execution IR and bounded reactive scheduling should reuse legacy deterministic compilation ideas without forcing all world behaviour through one geometry-oriented DAG.
Future red-team reviews must explicitly test for hidden SPDS assumptions leaking into current epistemic state, representation, morphology, solver and transaction models.
Where legacy implementation and current architecture disagree, current accepted Plasma architecture governs unless evidence from implementation stress testing justifies a new architecture decision.
architecture_updates.previous_approach: The current Plasma/Foundry specification had no explicit relationship to the older benresonance-star/PLASMA repository, creating a risk that future implementation agents would either ignore useful engineered mechanisms or incorrectly assume SPDS remains the governing architecture.

provenance.basis: Direct inspection of benresonance-star/PLASMA on GitHub and comparison of SPDS v1.2 with Plasma/Foundry v0.4.7 on 2026-09-09.

reason: The legacy implementation contains substantial operational and computational-design engineering that would be wasteful and risky to rediscover from scratch.

The newer Plasma architecture has deliberately moved beyond a semantic-parametric-model-as-truth worldview toward typed epistemic claims, accepted commitments, fields, solvers and context-dependent representations.
Making the inheritance boundary explicit allows future agents to reuse mechanisms without allowing historical package or ontology decisions to constrain the new architecture accidentally.
A machine-readable audit and red-team brief gives independent AI reviewers a concrete set of hypotheses to attack.
architecture_updates.title: Treat legacy SPDS repository as engineering ancestor, not current Plasma ontology

architecture_updates.adopted_approach: Plasma separates semantic/morphological control from sculptural surface realization. It supports multiresolution surfaces, local GPU sculpting, procedural/AI generation and specialist Blender/ZBrush round-trip while retaining stable object identity, semantic regions, attachments, constraints and lineage. Exact B-rep geometry remains a complementary fabrication/construction representation rather than a prerequisite for sculptural authoring.
consequences: Plasma may use subdivision/multiresolution meshes, sparse voxel or signed-distance representations, displacement/procedural detail and learned 3D realizations alongside OpenCascade/exact geometry.
High-resolution sculptural surfaces are leaf realizations governed by compact semantic controls rather than primary dependency nodes.
Specialist sculpting applications can be invoked as round-trip authoring adapters and their results rebound to existing semantic controls and object identity.
The Representation Resolver may choose silhouette, simplified morphology, design surface, fabrication surface or render microdetail according to view purpose and LOD.
Gaudí-oriented vertical slices should test whether vines, birds and sculptural junctions remain compositionally rich, directly editable and fabrication-aware after upstream stair/handrail changes.
architecture_updates.previous_approach: Freeform richness risked falling into either exact-solid parametric geometry that is too rigid for deep sculpting or imported high-poly meshes that behave as dead assets disconnected from architectural intent, attachment and fabrication logic.
reason: Gaudí-like architecture depends on sculptural depth, organic junctions, ornament and material expression that cannot be reduced to conventional BIM solids.
ZBrush-class richness is fundamentally a surface/multiresolution problem rather than a requirement for a Parasolid-class exact-solid kernel.
A monolithic attempt to rebuild every specialist sculpting capability inside Plasma would distract from Plasma's core role as the authoritative intent and relationship system.
Separating morphology from high-frequency surface detail allows major architectural changes to remain editable without waking millions of mesh dependencies.
Construction still requires exactness at interfaces, thicknesses, connections and manufacturing boundaries, so sculptural and exact representations must coexist and reconcile.
architecture_updates.title: Semantic morphogenesis and multiresolution sculptural realization

architecture_updates.adopted_approach: Immediate local coherence → bounded propagation → asynchronous global convergence. Mutations create local dirty regions and revision-tagged tasks; propagation expands only when boundary conditions change. Independent work is distributed across multicore CPU workers while dense field/spatial computation uses GPU kernels. Hierarchical summaries and explicit global invariants preserve correctness without traversing every dependency on every edit.
consequences: Plasma maintains explicit preview, latest-available and latest-mutually-coherent revisions rather than one blocking notion of current state.
Dependency edges include propagation/latency semantics and invalidation rules in addition to logical meaning.
Dirty-region propagation, boundary summaries, task cancellation and currentness metadata become core runtime contracts.
The browser/runtime uses a multicore worker pool; WASM/compiled kernels may use threads where appropriate while the main thread remains protected for interaction.

GPU compute is reserved for suitable dense parallel workloads such as terrain/slope/drainage fields, visibility, solar, distance fields and large candidate evaluation rather than generic graph traversal.
Performance is evaluated by interaction latency, touched dependency count, convergence time and invariant correctness—not merely raw solver throughput.
architecture_updates.previous_approach: Deep dependency graphs could imply immediate world-wide recomputation after each edit, causing interaction latency to scale with total graph size and encouraging GPU acceleration as a substitute for dependency architecture.
reason: The geodesic system demonstrated that highly coupled bound systems can lose direct-manipulation fluidity as dependency graphs grow.
Most architectural edits affect a small semantic/spatial neighbourhood even though the project contains many indirect downstream relationships.
CPU multithreading and GPU acceleration provide major value only when the runtime first limits and schedules the work intelligently.
Users need immediate trustworthy local feedback while heavier cost, compliance, field, documentation and whole-project checks can converge after the interaction.
architecture_updates.title: Bounded reactive computation and heterogeneous parallel runtime

architecture_updates.adopted_approach: Authoritative semantic object + explicit View Contract → Representation Resolver → contextual representation grammar. Stairs and ramps are the first stress test, generalized across architectural, civil, structural and services objects.
consequences: Documentation becomes a projection of authoritative world state.
View graphics are inspectable and explainable by their generating rules.
Representation-only overrides are explicit and cannot silently mutate geometry.
The resolver generalizes to stairs, ramps, roofs, terrain, doors, windows, services, structure and fabrication views.
architecture_updates.previous_approach: Geometry and documentation views existed without a general contract for storey-, cut-plane-, RCP-, discipline-, scale- and LOD-dependent representation.
reason: The same object must communicate differently across storeys, RCPs, sections, 3D and drawing scales.
Duplicated representations drift from design state.
Many drawing marks are communication constructs rather than physical geometry.
architecture_updates.title: Contextual representation as a first-class Plasma system

architecture_updates.adopted_approach: Evidence carries an applicability envelope and is retrieved against the current project's context fingerprint. Practice outcomes remain observations rather than rules. Humans work through architectural objects, decisions, questions and risks; the evidence graph is machine-managed underneath and revealed progressively only when relevant.
consequences: Reusable evidence requires explicit applicability/context metadata, preferably inherited automatically from project state.
Retrieval is similarity/context-match based and exposes why a precedent is or is not comparable.
The primary UI uses progressive disclosure: Result → Why → Evidence → Sources/History, attached to the relevant site/design/rule/decision object.
The runtime may contain millions of graph records while the architect sees only decision-relevant evidence and material exceptions.
Feasibility predictions are stored for later reconciliation but do not become training truth until real project feedback exists.

interaction_representation_contract.publication: Proxy state never self-promotes. Commit uses the authoritative Transform/Transaction path and must satisfy every representation/evaluator declared required-for-commit.

loops.name: Bounded Reactive Runtime + Parallel Compute
loops.next: Use a larger surveyed fixture with registration/breaklines, instrument all five performance boundaries and compare incremental versus full recomputation. Add a building-to-pad placement relation and driveway vertical transitions before stronger claims.
loops.performance_axiom: The cost of an ordinary edit should scale primarily with the affected region and required fidelity, not with total project size. Violations must be observable through instrumentation rather than hidden behind faster hardware.

performance_boundaries.contract: Only the active semantic/spatial working set is hot by default; unrelated world state remains cold until demanded by interaction, dependency propagation, validation or explicit background work.
performance_boundaries.name: Active World
performance_boundaries.question: What is computationally relevant now?

performance_boundaries.contract: Every mutation produces the smallest explicit dirty set and invalidation envelope that can be determined from changed facts, geometry, claims and boundary summaries.
performance_boundaries.name: Dirty Frontier
performance_boundaries.question: What actually changed?

performance_boundaries.contract: Propagation expands only as far as required to restore immediate invariants and materially changed boundaries; regional and global consequences may continue asynchronously.
performance_boundaries.name: Dependency Horizon
performance_boundaries.question: How far must consequences propagate now?

performance_boundaries.contract: Each task requests only the semantic, geometric, analytic and graphic fidelity it needs; expensive exact geometry, dense fields and high-detail representations are materialised lazily and cached as derived state.
performance_boundaries.name: Representation LOD
performance_boundaries.question: What fidelity does this operation actually require?

performance_boundaries.contract: Plasma distinguishes interaction-safe local coherence from regional and global coherence. Deferred results remain explicitly stale/pending/updating and may never masquerade as current.
performance_boundaries.name: Consistency Horizon
performance_boundaries.question: What must be correct immediately, and what may converge later?

stages: Establish Active World for the interaction/task
Tag mutation with world and input revision
Compute Dirty Frontier and invalidation envelope
Set Dependency Horizon from invariant and latency requirements
Select minimum Representation LOD required by each task
Set Consistency Horizon: immediate local versus deferred regional/global
Restore direct and local-hard invariants synchronously
Expand dirty region only across changed boundary conditions
Schedule independent CPU tasks across worker threads
Schedule dense homogeneous field/spatial work on GPU
Refine geometry and solver results progressively
Check global invariants through hierarchical summaries
Publish latest mutually coherent revision while retaining explicit currentness for pending results
loops.summary: Preserve fluid direct manipulation in highly dependent worlds by restoring the smallest necessary region of correctness first, then converging regional and global state asynchronously. Plasma partitions dependency propagation by semantic and spatial locality, uses revision-aware task scheduling across CPU threads and GPU compute, and treats currentness as explicit state rather than blocking interaction until the whole world is recomputed.

loops.flow: DESIGN INTENT + REFERENCES + MORPHOLOGY + FIELDS + CONSTRAINTS → SEMANTIC CONTROL STRUCTURE → GENERATIVE / AI / MANUAL SCULPTURAL REALIZATION → MULTIRESOLUTION SURFACE → FABRICATION REALIZATION → REPRESENTATION RESOLVER → DOCUMENT / RENDER / MANUFACTURE
loops.gap: A pure B-rep/parametric object model cannot efficiently express deeply sculpted ornament, organic junctions, birds, vines, figurative work, erosion-like stone forms or other freeform architectural richness. Conversely, importing a dead high-poly mesh severs intent-to-form linkage, editability, attachment logic, fabrication constraints and dependency traceability.

loops.next: Build a Gaudí balustrade vertical slice containing a semantic vine network, one perched bird asset and a sculptural junction. Support skeleton/cage-level edits, multiresolution surface refinement, GPU-local sculpt operations, representation LOD, fabrication checks, and Blender/ZBrush round-trip while preserving stable Plasma identity and attachment constraints.
stages: Declare semantic object, role and design intent
Create morphology graph, skeleton, cage, attachment and control regions
Generate or import coarse sculptural realization
Refine major masses independently of surface microdetail
Support local GPU sculpt operations and semantic AI edits
Round-trip specialist sculpting tools without surrendering Plasma identity
Bind high-resolution surface back to stable semantic controls
Resolve representation level separately for design, documentation, fabrication and rendering
Propagate upstream semantic changes through deformation/reprojection before regenerating detail
Preserve accepted sculptural revisions, provenance and reversible lineage

Plasma owns identity, intent, morphology, relationships, control structures, fabrication constraints and accepted realizations; high-resolution sculptural surfaces may be authored procedurally, by AI, directly in Plasma, or in specialist tools such as Blender/ZBrush and round-tripped without losing semantic ownership.

loops.flow: EVIDENCE + SOURCE + INTENT → TYPED CLAIM / BELIEF → UNCERTAINTY + AUTHORITY + VALIDITY → DEPENDENCY PROPAGATION → PROPOSAL → EVALUATION → ROBUSTNESS / RISK → COMMITMENT OR CONTEST → VALUE OF INFORMATION → TARGETED OBSERVATION / DECISION → UPDATED WORLD
loops.gap: The current world-state model carries provenance and some observation confidence, but does not yet provide a general epistemic contract for all facts, constraints, geometry, solver results and design decisions. Without it, assumptions can harden into apparent truth, compliance can appear binary despite uncertain inputs, dependency invalidation can be broader than necessary, and agents cannot reason explicitly about what should be learned next.
loops.implementation_note: The new synthetic site separates source samples from proposed deltas and labels unassessed checks. General claim status, uncertainty propagation, robust/fragile pass and value-of-information ranking remain planned; the current site slice does not claim them.
loops.name: Epistemic World + Value of Information
loops.next: Use terrain / driveway / pad as the first epistemic vertical slice. Represent survey points, inferred contours, title boundaries, crossover RLs, soil assumptions and planning interpretations as typed claims with source, status, authority, uncertainty and validity. Propagate uncertainty into grading, driveway compliance and pad levels; prove robust-pass / fragile-pass behavior; and compute a ranked value-of-information queue.
stages: Classify claim as known, observed, inferred, assumed, proposed, contested or unknown
Attach source, authority, confidence/uncertainty, validity interval and provenance
Keep observation, intent, proposal and accepted commitment distinct
Propagate uncertainty through dependent claims and representations
Use tolerance envelopes to define localized invalidation frontiers
Evaluate robust pass, fragile pass, indeterminate and fail rather than binary pass/fail alone
Expose spatial uncertainty and assumption-dependent regions in the UI
Prevent agents and solvers from silently promoting assumptions or derived results to truth
Estimate consequence sensitivity and value of information
Rank the next survey, question, test, expert input or client decision that most reduces consequential uncertainty
Commit validated evidence while preserving superseded beliefs and reversible lineage
loops.summary: Make uncertainty, provenance, authority and belief status first-class properties of Plasma world claims so the runtime can distinguish what is known, observed, inferred, assumed, proposed, contested and unknown; propagate uncertainty through dependent claims; distinguish robust from fragile compliance; identify the most valuable information to resolve next; and provide the typed epistemic states consumed and produced by PLS-13 reasoning operators.

loops.flow: HUMAN / AI ACTOR → DECLARED QUESTION + OPTIONAL REASONING LENS → SELECT / COMPOSE TYPED REASONING OPERATORS → READ EPISTEMIC WORLD + INTENT + RULES + FIELDS / SOLVERS → PRODUCE PUBLIC REASONING ARTEFACTS → PROPOSAL / CLAIM / QUESTION / EVALUATION → PREVIEW → VALIDATE → HUMAN-AUTHORISED COMMIT → WORLD REVISION
loops.gap: Plasma defines epistemic states, proposals, evidence and deterministic validation more clearly than it defines the reusable reasoning moves connecting them. Without a typed operator layer, reasoning can collapse observation into interpretation, AI workflows can become bespoke prompt chains, perspective-specific questions can be confused with competing world truth, and explanations can degrade into post-hoc prose rather than inspectable provenance.
loops.implementation_note: This remains an architectural contract, not an implementation claim. Implement the validation harness before broad runtime integration: one shared typed event/artefact schema, three replayable fixtures, cross-case schema assertions and anti-cheating invariants. Reuse existing ChangeSet, evidence, solver, rule, currentness and lineage infrastructure. Do not create autonomous agents per viewpoint by default; a reasoning lens may be a lightweight context object invoked by one capable model or deterministic evaluator.
loops.name: Typed Reasoning Operators + Contextual Lenses
loops.next: Validate the integrated RC-02 bedroom path under a normal browser origin with persisted proposal/commit, then measure physical desktop and iPhone interaction latency and currentness behaviour. After those integration gates, replay RC-01 terrain/driveway and RC-03 planning interpretation against the same retained reasoning-artefact schemas before adding operators.

Assign contextual meaning while preserving the observations it depends on.
Derive a claim with explicit premises, method and confidence or validity.
Make unresolved consequential uncertainty first-class rather than forcing premature closure.
Create a bounded candidate without mutating authoritative state.

operators.purpose: Actively seek disconfirming evidence, violated assumptions and boundary cases.

operators.input: two or more alternatives / revisions / claims
operators.purpose: Expose decision-relevant differences under declared criteria rather than flattening them into one score.

Interrogate one authoritative object from a declared role, discipline, stakeholder or purpose without cloning truth.
Run a deterministic check, solver, experiment, retrieval or measurement whose result can support or challenge a claim.
Record an explicit governed choice, its basis and authority without pretending uncertainty disappeared.
Change the accepted model while preserving the superseded state and causal lineage.

reasoning_lens_contract.rule: A lens changes the questions, criteria, weighting or interpretation context applied to an authoritative world object; it does not own alternate geometry or silently override accepted facts.

do_not_require: post-hoc causal prose presented as provenance
reasoning_trace_contract.principle: Plasma stores inspectable reasoning products and typed transitions sufficient for audit, explanation and replay; it does not depend on exposing or preserving a model's private internal reasoning process.

anti_cheating_invariants: Narrative prose alone never satisfies an operator assertion.
No inferred or interpreted value may overwrite its source observation or masquerade as measured fact.
A lens may alter questions, criteria or weighting but may not silently alter authoritative geometry, facts, rules or authority.
A deterministic check must cite the exact inputs and rule/tool/solver version that produced the result.
A decision must identify the actor/authority that committed it; AI recommendation alone is not commitment unless explicitly authorized by policy.
A revised belief supersedes rather than deletes the prior belief and preserves the evidence that caused the change.
The harness must be able to replay a trace without access to private model chain-of-thought.
cross_case_assertions: Observation remains distinct from interpretation in terrain and planning cases.
Proposal remains distinct from committed world state in terrain and bedroom cases.
Test/evaluate cite deterministic machinery in terrain and bedroom cases and source/applicability machinery in planning.
Question can remain unresolved and drive value-of-information rather than being forced into a conclusion.
Decide records authority and basis in all three cases.
Revise preserves supersession lineage when new survey evidence, a changed design decision or a clarified planning interpretation arrives.
Perspective/lens changes interrogation context without cloning the underlying object or rule set.
reasoning_validation_harness.fixture_rule: Fixtures are synthetic and versioned. Their numerical values are test data, not regulatory or professional advice. Each replay pins world revision, claim/evidence ids, rule/tool versions, lens version and expected trace assertions.
minimum_metrics: trace completeness: required public-artifact fields populated
provenance resolution: every material claim resolves to evidence/world/tool/rule refs
semantic stability: same operator schema validates across cases
unresolved-state honesty: consequential unknowns remain explicit

operator_retention_gate.default_rule: Retain an operator as a Plasma primitive only when the same input/output semantics recur in at least two materially different validation cases without domain-specific meaning leaking into the operator contract.
operator_retention_gate.exception_rule: A one-case operator may remain only when it protects a demonstrated epistemic or governance boundary that cannot be safely represented by composition of retained operators; the exception requires an ADR and red-team case.
operator_retention_gate.failure_rule: If the three cases require bespoke orchestration with little reusable operator semantics, remove PLS-13 as a primitive layer and retain only reasoning traces over ordinary typed events.
operator_retention_gate.merge_rule: If two operators repeatedly produce the same typed transition and differ only by prompt wording, merge them.
operator_retention_gate.split_rule: If one operator requires incompatible input/output semantics across cases, split the domain-specific behaviour into a capability/lens before splitting the primitive.

reasoning_validation_harness.purpose: Test whether the proposed reasoning operators are genuinely reusable architecture rather than renamed domain workflow steps or AI-prompt conventions.

loops.summary: Define a small composable set of public, typed reasoning operations that transform evidence, claims, intent, questions, alternatives and evaluations into inspectable epistemic artefacts; allow declared contextual lenses to change which questions and criteria are applied to the same authoritative world object without duplicating that object or creating a second source of truth.

The value-of-information question points to a targeted missing fact rather than requesting a generic full resurvey.
Stale deterministic results cannot support a final decision.

runtime_contract.principle: The gesture is free to explore beyond a constraint inside a speculative branch; hard-invalid state may be displayed and reasoned about but cannot be promoted to a coherent authoritative revision until the conflict is resolved or the governing constraint is changed through an authorized separate decision.

scheduler_contract.ai_reasoning: AI may be invoked at conflict, pointer-up, idle, explicit ask or alternative-generation stage. It consumes typed world/evaluation state and emits proposals/questions/explanations; it does not own geometry truth or commit authority.
scheduler_contract.local_hard: Evaluate commit-critical local hard constraints against the newest candidate sequence synchronously-by-policy or with a bounded deterministic worker path; if not current, mark pending and disable authoritative commit rather than guessing.
scheduler_contract.local_soft: Run only material soft/negotiable checks; they may trail the pointer and converge after release with explicit currentness.
scheduler_contract.measurement: Benchmarks must separately report pointer feedback, local-hard currentness latency, alternative-ready latency, commit-ready latency and regional/global convergence; do not hide them inside one average.
scheduler_contract.pointer_loop: No LLM/model call is required or permitted as a dependency of per-pointer-update responsiveness. Pointer/viewport feedback and speculative geometry are first priority.
scheduler_contract.regional_global: Schedule only after boundary summaries indicate material propagation or after release/commit policy requires them.
scheduler_contract.stale_work: Every task is tagged with session_id, sequence, candidate/world revision and producer version. Older results are cancelled where possible or discarded when they return.
