runtime_prototype_evidence.hot_path: applyPointerIntent preserves exact requested delta, emits speculative candidate + DirtyFrontier + current hard evaluation synchronously, and contains no LLM/model dependency.
runtime_prototype_evidence.idempotency: Command-cache keys are scoped by session for session commands; duplicate delivery within a session returns the prior result without appending/reapplying events.
open_gates: persistent transactional event store and restart replay
real geometry/OCCT adapter rather than synthetic scalar corridor evaluation
multi-user transport, permissions and concurrent edit reconciliation
independently authenticated evidence collector and release-bundle proof
reuse pressure-test through RC-01 terrain and RC-03 planning before freezing the generic contract
runtime_prototype_evidence.replay: The executable test suite rebuilds committed state from the event log using only the pure reducer and checks world head, event count, session status and candidate identity.
runtime_prototype_evidence.state_model: Pure reduceEditRuntimeState(state,event) + append-only InMemoryEditEventStore; UI/query state is reconstructed from public events rather than component-local authority.

schema_family.validation_rule: Structural schema validation and semantic invariant validation are separate. A structurally valid event cannot bypass commit, authority, currentness or dependency invariants.

after_release: retain the requested candidate so intent is not lost
present feasible/coupled/abandon alternatives with explicit mutations and consequences
do not rank hard compliance against design quality as one opaque scalar
allow a user to inspect drivers/dependents and the exact reasoning trace on demand
permit 'keep as conflicted branch/preview' for exploration while preventing authoritative publication
during_drag: preserve direct pointer/viewport feedback ahead of reasoning UI
show a visible hard-boundary marker when crossed
allow conflicted ghost preview beyond the boundary rather than automatically clamping
show the smallest useful inline conflict card: object, measured value, requirement, deficit and source/why affordance
keep soft/advisory statuses visually distinct from hard commit blockers
show current/updating/pending/stale state where a result is not yet current
ui_contract.progressive_disclosure: The default surface stays architectural: geometry, dimension, conflict boundary and alternatives. Rule provenance, lens invocations, traces and task telemetry expand only when requested or materially ambiguous.

acceptance_tests: Source observation, interpretation, inference, evaluation and decision are separately inspectable and independently supersedable.
Historical cases are context-bounded evidence packets with authority/version/applicability metadata, not silent governing rules.
When ambiguity is consequential and unresolved, the result can remain indeterminate and escalate rather than forcing a binary answer.
A later authoritative clarification supersedes the working interpretation while preserving what was previously believed and why.
Project geometry/feasibility depending on the interpretation is marked with currentness/fragility appropriate to that claim status.

fixture.authority_model: AI may recommend; configured human/planning authority decides project working interpretation; external authority outcome may later supersede the working interpretation without rewriting history.
fixture.governing_source: RULE-P-07@1 synthetic clause with an intentionally ambiguous applicability phrase.
historical_cases: CASE-A: close contextual match supporting interpretation A
CASE-B: superficially similar but different governing-version/context supporting interpretation B
CASE-C: authority outcome with missing reasoning and lower evidentiary weight
site_facts: proposed upper-storey element intersects a defined test envelope

forbidden: Convert an AI interpretation directly into a governing deterministic rule without an authority/status transition.
Use precedent from a different governing version/site context without exposing the mismatch.
Erase the prior interpretation after clarification.
Report certainty because multiple low-quality historical cases agree.
validation_cases.name: Ambiguous planning text → provisional interpretation with bounded precedent
validation_cases.objective: Prove that statutory/source observation, contextual interpretation, inference, precedent, ambiguity, authority and later revision remain distinct, so AI can assist planning reasoning without turning precedent or fluent interpretation into governing truth.
validation_cases.pass_evidence: Replay bundle with source/version refs, competing interpretation claims, applicability scores, historical-case context fingerprints, unresolved questions, governed decision, injected clarification and supersession propagation.
perturbations: Remove CASE-A and verify the system does not fabricate support.
Change CASE-B to the same governing version but retain a materially different site condition.
Inject a higher-authority clarification that conflicts with the working interpretation.
Change a site fact so applicability flips while the source text is unchanged.
Give the AI a persuasive but uncited narrative and verify it cannot enter accepted context without typed evidence/authority.

required_operator_trace.assert: Store exact governing source/version and project/site facts separately from interpretation.
Produce one or more explicit applicability interpretations tied to text spans/context rather than converting prose directly into a hard rule.
Derive provisional project consequences from each interpretation using explicit premises.
Apply planning/evidence-quality lenses without changing the source text or project facts.
Search exceptions, context mismatch, source-version mismatch and counterexamples; do not treat historical cases as universal precedent.
Represent material ambiguity as an unresolved question when evidence cannot safely resolve it.
Compare interpretations on source fit, context fit, authority, consequence and uncertainty rather than confidence prose alone.
Rank source/precedent applicability and identify any fragile conclusion dependent on weak historical evidence.
Record a governed working interpretation or escalation requirement with explicit authority and risk posture.
When a clarified governing source or authority response is injected, supersede the working interpretation and propagate only affected consequences while preserving the earlier decision basis.

acceptance_tests: Same accepted world revision is addressable through at least three different lens compositions without divergent geometry/facts.
A selected wall exposes concise drivers/dependents and can expand into an explicit relationship X-Ray with typed edge provenance.
A hard-boundary drag can cross into a visible speculative state; the requested intent remains represented while publication is blocked.
Blast-radius overlay is derived from runtime dependency/currentness data and distinguishes current, pending, stale and unknown consequences.
Switching evaluation lens does not mutate authoritative state or reinterpret a hard rule without a separate governed decision.
A novice can discover an operation from direct/contextual affordance or natural language while an expert can inspect the underlying typed operation and parameters.
UI remains functional with AI services unavailable for selection, direct manipulation, deterministic checks and commit gating.
A proposed UI refactor is previewed in a sandbox and does not activate until explicit acceptance; rollback restores the prior version.
A generated capability cannot promote until predeclared tests, guided human validation, affected-world replay and exact-digest approval complete.
Neutral/Inspect mode can reproduce enough explicit structure, relationships and versions to debug a project independent of one user's personalized lens.

allowed: generate a sandboxed project-specific UI surface for a capability
adapt input affordance to mouse/Pencil/touch while preserving operation semantics
forbidden: silent overnight rearrangement of professional workflows
personalization that changes authoritative model semantics
personalization that hides a hard constraint or warning
non-reproducible UI state required to understand or replay a committed edit
adaptive_ui_governance.principle: Adaptive, not unstable. Personalization can suggest and compose; it cannot silently replace learned workflows or governing semantics.
requires_acceptance: remove or rename a familiar operation
replace a workflow with a synthesized one
promote a generated UI/capability from sandbox
share a personal lens as team/project default
stable_modes: Neutral/Inspect mode with predictable project-wide behavior
project presentation/client lens with bounded permissions
adaptive_ui_governance.versioning: Accepted lens definitions, gesture maps and synthesized workflows are versioned artifacts with provenance, compatibility and rollback.

anti_pattern_projection_contract.default_behavior: No global warning dashboard or modal cascade. Show the smallest local marker capable of explaining a material consequence at the edited object/operation, with deeper reasoning on demand.
interaction_levels: hint: subtle local mark; no interruption
warning: local consequence summary plus alternatives; user may continue if policy permits
hold: publication paused pending explicit disposition/authority
block: no publication because kernel integrity or governing hard authority forbids the candidate
anti_pattern_projection_contract.novelty_rule: The UI must not style merely unusual/rare geometry as an error. Novelty/plausibility flags are visually and semantically distinct from corruption, hard conflicts and evidence-backed domain hazards.
anti_pattern_projection_contract.relationship: Consumes PLS-16 findings as an optional evaluation overlay; PLS-14 does not own anti-pattern truth or blocking authority.
required_content: whether the user may proceed and under what authority

anti_patterns: Invisible toolbar: hide commands but still require expert vocabulary.
AI executes natural language directly into authoritative geometry without preview/typed operation.
Delete the explicit hierarchy because spatial UI exists.
Use camera zoom alone to determine semantic disclosure.
Treat a lens as a separate copy of the model.
Run every evaluator synchronously on every pointer update.
Allow an adaptive UI to silently change gesture meaning or hide warnings.
Assume cloud geometry is required for a lightweight client.
Claim passing generated tests makes a capability trustworthy or complete.
Claim co-evolving app/content makes technical debt impossible.

capability_extension_harness.principle: The application may evolve with project needs, but extensions execute through bounded capability contracts rather than arbitrary self-modification.
sequence: run guided human validation from simple → nominal → edge/failure cases
optionally promote to shared/global library after stronger evidence
retain dependency pins + migration + rollback/deprecation path
capability_extension_harness.technical_debt_rule: Self-extending software can accumulate technical debt faster, not slower. API compatibility, schema discipline, duplication detection, dependency pins, deprecation, migration, provenance and reproducibility are mandatory.
capability_extension_harness.test_truth: Passing tests demonstrates conformance to the pinned test contract; it does not prove physical, regulatory or domain completeness. Provenance, authority, uncertainty and independent evaluation still apply.

device_contract.desktop: Precise pointer/raycasting, keyboard accelerators and optional context menus may expose depth quickly.
device_contract.shared_semantics: Device adaptation changes affordance geometry and invocation, not world semantics, authority, evaluation rules or operation identity.
device_contract.tablet: Touch/Pencil targets, proximity/hover when available, pinch/pan/orbit and haptics/visual snap cues must map to the same typed operations rather than a separate reduced product.

loops.flow: ACTOR + TASK + SELECTION + VIEW CONTEXT → SEMANTIC RELEVANCE RESOLVER → COMPOSE LENS STACK → SURFACE MINIMUM AFFORDANCES / RELATIONSHIPS → EDIT INTENT → SPECULATIVE PREVIEW WORLD → DIRTY FRONTIER + DEPENDENCY HORIZON → BLAST-RADIUS / CURRENTNESS OVERLAY → HUMAN / POLICY CHOICE → VALIDATE → COMMIT OR KEEP/BRANCH PREVIEW → OPTIONAL UI/CAPABILITY REFACTOR PROPOSAL → SANDBOX + TEST + ACCEPT → VERSIONED LENS/CAPABILITY
loops.gap: Plasma already has contextual representation, local speculative revisions, currentness, reasoning lenses and direct-manipulation conflict semantics, but no single interaction contract connects them. Without it, minimalist UI can merely hide complexity, relationship overlays can become visual clutter, discipline modes can fragment into separate workspaces, and adaptive/AI-generated UI can become unstable or bypass governance.

lens_taxonomy.composition_rule: A user-visible lens is normally a composition of the three layers. Example: Thermal Design may request thermal representation, expose window/junction manipulation affordances and activate only materially affected thermal evaluators. Compositions are named/versioned recipes, not duplicate project models.

evaluation_lens.must_not: Change governing facts, authority or pass/fail semantics merely by changing visual mode.
evaluation_lens.question: What consequences, criteria, solvers or checks matter for this task now?
evaluation_lens.relationship: May invoke PLS-13 reasoning lenses/operators and PLS-10 bounded computation; it is not identical to a reasoning lens.

interaction_lens.must_not: Invent permissions, constraints or model semantics. Every action resolves to a typed operation against authoritative state.
interaction_lens.question: What can this actor meaningfully do here, and how should those actions be exposed?

representation_lens.must_not: Own alternate authoritative geometry or silently mutate the represented object.
representation_lens.question: What should be visible and how should authoritative state be represented?
representation_lens.relationship: Implemented through/alongside PLS-09 View Contracts and contextual representation grammars.

loops.name: Adaptive Interaction Lens Runtime
loops.next: Build one wall/room vertical slice across desktop and iPad-class input. Selection should resolve a small semantic-relevance set, show editable affordances plus concise drivers/dependents, enter Relationship X-Ray on demand, preview a 500 mm conflicted move with blast radius and alternatives, switch between Spatial, Compliance and Cost lens compositions without cloning world state, and prove that the same operation remains usable with AI services unavailable. Then sandbox one proposed UI refinement and require explicit acceptance before activation.

preview_world_and_blast_radius_contract.principle: Predict consequences from the same dependency/runtime machinery that will validate the change; do not fabricate a post-hoc animation of impact.
preview_world_and_blast_radius_contract.relationship_to_runtime: PLS-10 Dirty Frontier, Dependency Horizon and Consistency Horizon are the execution substrate; PLS-14 defines their interactive projection.
stages: open speculative revision from accepted base
apply requested intent without immediately discarding/clamping it
render ghosted candidate + affected objects + currentness
offer exact boundary and typed alternatives where available
commit with authority or retain/discard/branch preview
truthfulness: Unknown/deferred consequences display as pending/stale, never as safe.
A blast radius may be conservative but must state when it is incomplete.
If a relationship is not represented in the dependency graph, the UI may not claim that no consequence exists.

relationship_bond_contract.hierarchy_rule: A conventional hierarchy/tree remains available as an inspectable projection. Plasma removes dependence on the tree as the primary workflow, not the ability to inspect structure explicitly.
relationship_bond_contract.principle: Treat graph relationships as inspectable spatial bonds when useful, while preserving the underlying typed graph as the authority.
ui_rules: Default selection shows only concise material drivers/dependents.
Relationship X-Ray reveals additional bonds on demand.
Aggregate relationships by semantic depth; never render the full graph as a ball of yarn.
Breaking/revising a relationship creates a typed proposal/change event; swiping/cutting a visual tether is only an interaction mapped to that operation.

semantic_relevance_contract.budget: Do not invoke every discipline/evaluator on every pointer event; the resolver must respect the PLS-10 interaction budget and dependency horizon.
semantic_relevance_contract.escape_hatch: Users can always open explicit Inspect/Structure mode to query objects, hierarchy, dependencies, versions and hidden relations directly.
semantic_relevance_contract.rule: Relevance is task- and dependency-aware, not merely camera-distance semantic zoom. Scale can influence disclosure but never solely determines it.

spatial_verb_surface_contract.compiler_rule: Gestures and language aliases resolve to the same typed operation/Transform contract. Natural language is not a privileged mutation path and may not bypass authority, invariants or ambiguity resolution.
spatial_verb_surface_contract.complexity_rule: Prefer simple verbs plus contextual modifiers/overrides over command proliferation. Internal sophistication increases inward; it should not be forced into the user permanent interface.
language_shortcut_examples: pull this face to grid C
cut these panels with that profile
align these openings and preserve sill height
spatial_verb_surface_contract.precision_rule: Free manipulation is continuously convertible into exact input: a drag may become +315 mm, 45°, aligned-to-reference or equal-spacing without entering a separate precision mode.
spatial_verb_surface_contract.principle: Expose a small stable vocabulary of spatial actions across mouse, touch, pen, voice and AI. Domain context supplies nouns and semantics; modifiers refine behavior without proliferating bespoke commands.

loops.summary: Project maximum capability with minimum irrelevant interface. Plasma keeps authoritative world state, relationships, constraints, provenance and machinery explicit and inspectable, while resolving a temporary lens stack for what is shown, how it can be manipulated and what should be evaluated now. Lenses never become alternate truth. Direct manipulation produces speculative preview worlds whose dependency-backed blast radius is visible before publication. UI and capability evolution may be proposed by humans or AI, but changes are versioned, sandboxed, tested, human-accepted and reversible rather than silently personalized or rewritten.

acceptance_tests: RC-02 wall move compiles only the material local hard work during interaction; no general planner/model is required in the pointer loop and accepted state follows the existing kernel transaction path.
Terrain/pad/driveway edit creates a bounded work plan whose derived spatial dependencies change when topology/boundary conditions change; stale dependency closures cannot claim unaffected regions.

A synthetic cyclic structure-height-envelope fixture is detected as a strongly connected component and scheduled as an explicit bounded solve unit with visible convergence/failure status rather than forced into an invalid DAG.

An overnight townhouse exploration can persist hundreds of WorkItems, restart from serialized plan state, reuse revision-matched completed outputs and reject stale work after the base world or producer version changes.
Duplicate execution of a retryable task cannot duplicate canonical mutation; compare-and-swap/idempotency leaves at most one accepted publication.
An AI WorkItem receives a revision-pinned context capsule containing only required semantic/evidence/rule/tool context and its result cannot self-promote to accepted truth.
Background GPU/model workloads cannot starve pointer/commit-critical work and scheduling metrics expose queue/resource contention.

An irreversible/high-consequence external WorkItem cannot run without explicit side-effect authority and produces reconciliation evidence; ambiguous completion remains unknown rather than auto-retried.
Graph projections can be discarded and rebuilt from the same authoritative revision without changing project meaning or identity.
A dependency edge and an explicit causal claim are distinguishable in schemas, explanations and evidence requirements.

context_capsule_contract.ai_rule: Model context is a disposable execution input. The model may return proposals, questions, explanations or derived artefacts; it never becomes the canonical store of project state.
context_capsule_contract.context_cache_rule: Context capsules may be cached only against exact input/world/producer versions; stale capsules cannot be reused by implication.
context_capsule_contract.purpose: Generate the smallest inspectable context required by a WorkItem so AI/tool execution is grounded in world structure rather than whole-project prompt dumping.

cycle_and_loop_contract.detection: Before DAG scheduling, compute strongly connected components or equivalent cycle groups in the relevant dependency/execution projection.
cycle_and_loop_contract.failure_rule: Non-convergence, oscillation or budget exhaustion is an explicit result, not permission to publish the last iterate as valid.
cycle_and_loop_contract.problem: Architectural dependencies are not necessarily acyclic: structure ↔ floor depth ↔ height/envelope, mass ↔ wind ↔ structure and layout ↔ daylight ↔ opening placement are feedback systems.
cycle_and_loop_contract.rule: Collapse a bounded cycle into an explicit solve unit for scheduling rather than pretending the full world is a DAG. Each iteration may expose an internal DAG, but the feedback semantics remain inspectable.

dependency_semantics.dynamic_discovery: Spatial contacts, clashes, shadows, rule applicability, solver couplings, topology and other derived dependencies may appear or disappear as world state changes. Such edges are revisioned derived state and must be refreshed at declared discovery boundaries before Plasma can claim a dependency closure is complete.
dependency_semantics.rule: Do not collapse these into one generic edge type. In particular, upstream/downstream dependency does not establish causation unless a typed causal claim with method/evidence exists.
dependency_semantics.unknown_rule: If dependency discovery is incomplete, consequence scope is unknown/conservative; the runtime and UI may not claim 'unaffected' merely because no edge is currently present.

durability_and_recovery_contract.crash_rule: An ambiguous crash during an external side effect resolves to unknown/pending reconciliation, never assumed success or safe retry.
durability_and_recovery_contract.delivery_semantics: Execution may be at-least-once; canonical publication must be effectively exactly-once through idempotency + kernel compare-and-swap/transaction semantics. External side effects require stronger dedupe or compensation contracts.
durability_and_recovery_contract.principle: Long-running work must survive process/browser/service restart independently of prior in-memory scheduler objects.
resume_sequence: revalidate base/input revisions and capability versions
resume only work whose authority and side-effect preconditions still hold

execution_plan_contract.minimality_rule: Prefer the smallest plan that can restore required correctness or answer the current question. Do not generate universal all-discipline work merely because capabilities exist.
execution_plan_contract.mutation_rule: Plan changes are versioned. Running work remains attached to the plan/input revision that created it; replanning cannot silently reinterpret an in-flight result.
execution_plan_contract.planner_rule: A deterministic planner, AI model, human or hybrid process may propose an ExecutionPlan. Planning authority does not imply execution or publication authority.

loops.flow: GOAL / EVENT / DIRTY FRONTIER / INFORMATION NEED → RESOLVE AFFECTED WORLD + REQUIRED OUTCOMES → BUILD REVISION-PINNED EXECUTION PLAN → DISCOVER/REFRESH DEPENDENCIES → DETECT CYCLES + FORM BOUNDED SOLVE UNITS → MATERIALISE MINIMUM CONTEXT CAPSULES → SCHEDULE BY DEPENDENCY / LATENCY / RESOURCE / AUTHORITY → EXECUTE HUMAN / DETERMINISTIC / SOLVER / AI / EXTERNAL WORK → VALIDATE OUTPUT + EVIDENCE + CURRENTNESS → PROPOSE / DERIVE / COMMIT THROUGH PLS-KERNEL-01 → PERSIST PLAN STATE + RESUME / CANCEL / SUPERSEDE AS REQUIRED
loops.gap: PLS-10 already defines bounded reactive scheduling for local edits and the legacy engineering inheritance retains execution DAGs, but Plasma does not yet have one general durable contract for a unit of work, long-running execution plans, dynamic dependency discovery, feedback cycles, context assembly, retry/recovery, resource assignment or side-effect governance. Without it, overnight exploration and multi-solver workflows risk becoming bespoke agent loops, opaque prompt chains, fragile in-memory DAGs or globally coupled dependency traversals.

graph_projection_doctrine.anti_pattern: Do not create four independent databases called WorldGraph, CausalGraph, EvidenceGraph and WorkGraph with competing mutation paths.
graph_projection_doctrine.authority_rule: A graph projection may be cached and indexed for performance, but it must name the world/input revision and producer version from which it was derived. Rebuild or invalidation must never require preserving graph identity as architectural truth.
graph_projection_doctrine.principle: Plasma has one authoritative semantic world. Graphs are query/compile projections over exact revisions, not additional truth stores.

projections.dependency_invalidation: Derived view answering what may become stale or require recomputation when an input changes. Dependency is not automatically a claim of physical causation.
projections.evidence_provenance: Derived view linking claims, observations, rules, tools, decisions, Events and Evidence for explanation, audit and applicability checking.
projections.execution_work: Ephemeral-or-durable plan view describing required work, precedence, blocking, parallelism, loops, resources and completion state. Work graph state cannot directly mutate canonical project state.
projections.semantic_relation: Entity/Relation-oriented view for structure, ownership, composition, spatial and domain relationships.

loops.implementation_note: Do not begin by building a general distributed agent platform. Implement the minimum durable WorkItem/ExecutionPlan store and scheduler needed by the three acceptance fixtures, reusing the existing PLS-10 dirty-frontier/currentness machinery, PLS-KERNEL-01 transaction path and event/idempotency conventions. Escalate to distributed queues, GPU routing or multi-agent planning only when measured workload requires them.
loops.name: Work Orchestration + Execution Graph Runtime
loops.next: Implement a small durable PLS-15 reference runtime around three fixtures: RC-02 bedroom move, terrain/pad/driveway propagation and an overnight multi-alternative townhouse exploration. Prove revision-pinned WorkItems, dynamic dependency updates, SCC/cycle handling, stale-work rejection, restart/resume and exact-once canonical publication while reusing PLS-10 for the interactive hot path.

observability_contract.explain_rule: For any active or completed WorkItem Plasma can explain why it exists, what it reads, what it is waiting on, who/what may execute it, what it produced, whether the result is current and what publication step remains.
minimum_metrics: queue and execution latency by class

output_adjudication_contract.anti_pattern_integration: A WorkItem or ExecutionPlan may request PLS-16 evaluators from affected scope and risk class. Work completion never waives a pathology finding, and the executor that produced an output cannot grant itself an exception to a high-consequence finding.
output_adjudication_contract.principle: Executors propose; Plasma adjudicates. Human, deterministic, solver, AI and external-machine outputs traverse the same evidence/currentness/invariant/pathology evaluation gates before any canonical publication.
output_adjudication_contract.scheduling_rule: Low-cost deterministic corruption checks may be mandatory preflight. Expensive fabrication, construction, project-entropy or reasoning scans may be scheduled on release/background according to PLS-10/PLS-15 latency and resource policy.
output_adjudication_contract.stale_rule: A finding is valid only for its pinned world/input revision and detector version; stale findings must be recomputed or explicitly marked unknown before publication decisions rely on them.

scheduler_contract.relationship_to_pls10: PLS-10 remains the bounded reactive substrate. PLS-15 supplies durable plan/work semantics above it; PLS-10 may execute or schedule individual runnable items under interaction/currentness budgets.
rules: schedule only when predecessors, authority and required-currentness conditions are satisfied
prefer reuse of current revision-matched outputs over recomputation
cancel superseded cancellable work; discard late non-cancellable outputs
protect interactive latency from background saturation
prevent indefinite starvation of valid lower-priority work through explicit fairness/aging policy
record queue, run, wait, retry and convergence timings separately

classes.external_compensatable: Writes to an external system with explicit idempotency and/or compensating action.
classes.irreversible_high_consequence: Physical fabrication/robot motion, submission, purchase or other action where retry/rollback may be impossible or costly.
classes.pure: Read/compute only; safe to retry if inputs/version match.
classes.reversible_local: Changes isolated Plasma candidate/derived state and can be discarded or compensated without external consequence.

side_effect_contract.robotics_rule: A robot work item references an accepted world/plan revision and cannot infer permission from an AI planner completing successfully.
side_effect_contract.rule: Scheduling authority is distinct from side-effect authority. Irreversible/high-consequence items require explicit preflight state, bounded execution window, human/policy authorization and post-action evidence/reconciliation.

loops.summary: Compile goals, world changes, invalidations and required evaluations into durable, inspectable, revision-pinned work plans without making an execution graph or agent graph authoritative world state. Plasma retains one semantic world; graph structures are typed projections used for dependency analysis, context assembly, scheduling, concurrency, recovery and observability. Humans, AI models, deterministic functions, solvers, CPU/GPU workers and external machines are replaceable executors of work items under the same authority/evidence/transaction contracts.

minimum_fields: base world revision + candidate revision where applicable
work_item_contract.publication_rule: Canonical mutation still requires the normal Transform/Transaction/Evaluate/Commit path. Derived outputs remain revision-keyed derived state unless promoted through that path.
work_item_contract.success_rule: WorkItem success means its output contract completed for the pinned inputs. It does not mean the output is accepted world truth, compliant, optimal or authorized to publish.

acceptance_tests: A primitive operation that would create a dangling canonical relation is rejected before canonical mutation and records a corrupting finding/evidence trail.

A novel but structurally valid sculptural geometry receives no error merely because it is rare; an AI plausibility detector may flag uncertainty but cannot block without independent governing evidence.
RC-02 +500 mm preserves a conflicted speculative world while the active hard corridor Invariant blocks publication; PLS-16 does not pretend this is merely an advisory anti-pattern.

A fabrication fixture accumulated across multiple commits detects 20 near-identical panel types clustering into approximately 3 manufacturing-significant families and offers rationalization without forcing it.
A low-value/high-disruption edit produces a multi-dimensional ChangeCoherenceAssessment and lower-impact alternatives without collapsing architectural value to an opaque scalar.
A detector result pinned to R12 is marked stale or recomputed after R13 changes its applicability inputs; R12 finding cannot silently govern R13.
An accepted exception creates an immutable ExceptionRecord with authority, rationale, evidence, scope and review/expiry trigger; the original finding remains addressable.
A high-consequence AI-generated proposal cannot self-waive its own pathology finding and follows the same publication gate as an equivalent human proposal.
Pointer interaction remains within the PLS-10 budget because expensive project/history scans are deferred and incremental.
Repeated organization evidence may create a proposed anti-pattern definition, but it cannot become active/blocking until validation/promotion criteria are met.

agent_and_tool_governance.bulk_generation: Overnight/multi-agent generation must batch/incrementally evaluate candidate families so pathology is caught before hundreds of dependent variants inherit it.
agent_and_tool_governance.context_rule: Detectors receive the smallest sufficient context capsule plus explicit unknowns; a causal slice that omits materially required context must downgrade confidence or request expansion rather than fabricate project understanding.
agent_and_tool_governance.same_pipeline: AI, scripts, solvers and human edits receive the same revision-pinned anti-pattern/invariant evaluation for equivalent effects.
agent_and_tool_governance.self_waiver_rule: A producer cannot silently suppress, downgrade or exception its own high-consequence finding.

anti_patterns_of_the_guard: Treat every rare state as suspicious and gradually normalize design toward the training corpus.
Convert advisory anti-patterns into hidden hard rules.
Allow an LLM plausibility score to block publication by itself.
Run every detector on every pointer event.
Maintain a second mutable issue database whose state can diverge from world/evidence revisions.
Let stale findings govern a newer candidate.
Permit the producing agent/tool to self-approve a high-risk exception.
Use one opaque universal quality score in place of typed consequences and evidence.
Learn organization rules from frequency without counterexamples or applicability boundaries.
Suppress the user requested state by auto-clamping before they can inspect the conflict.

causal_pathology_contract.relationship_to_pls15: PLS-15 SCC/cycle machinery detects execution/dependency loops. PLS-16 classifies when a loop is expected/solvable versus pathological, and may propose typed remedies such as hard/soft/observer/derived relationship reclassification.
causal_pathology_contract.rule: A cycle is not automatically an error. Feedback systems may be legitimate; pathology depends on declared solve semantics, convergence, authority and boundedness.

change_coherence_contract.default_rule: Preserve the vector and explanation. Do not collapse to a single score unless a project explicitly adopts a transparent weighting policy.
change_coherence_contract.intent_rule: Absence of machine-understood intent lowers confidence; it does not prove the operation is nonsensical.
change_coherence_contract.name: ChangeCoherenceAssessment
change_coherence_contract.purpose: Identify suspicious operations whose declared benefit appears small relative to the disturbance they create without pretending architectural value can be reduced to one universal scalar.
change_coherence_contract.trigger_example: A 40 mm kitchen move that yields negligible spatial benefit but changes joinery, plumbing, tiling, ceiling coordination and creates unique types may emit a low-value/high-disruption advisory with lower-impact alternatives.

classes.coherence_suspicion: Operation appears to produce little declared intent gain relative to complexity, disruption, uncertainty or irreversibility. Advisory unless another governing condition gives it stronger authority.
classes.corrupting: Violates kernel integrity, primitive-operation validity, canonical referential/schema integrity or creates a state the runtime cannot safely represent. Blocking; no ordinary override.
classes.hard_governance: Conflicts with an active hard Invariant or policy whose authority explicitly blocks promotion. Resolve by changing the candidate or by a separate authorized decision that changes the governing Invariant/policy; do not silently waive it inside the same edit.
classes.hazardous: Evidence-backed condition with serious likely domain consequence but not itself a kernel/hard-invariant failure. Normally hold/review or strong warning according to declared policy and authority.
classes.known_anti_pattern: Recognized condition associated with waste, fragility, coordination risk, fabrication difficulty, maintenance burden or poor outcomes. Warn and provide remediation/alternatives; exception normally allowed with rationale.
classes.novel_or_unusual: Rare, unfamiliar or low-prior state without sufficient negative evidence. Flag only when useful for scrutiny; never present as an error merely because it is atypical.
classes.unknown: Detector lacks sufficient applicability, evidence, currentness or dependency closure. Preserve unknown explicitly rather than treating absence of a finding as safety.

classification_model.separation_rule: Severity, confidence and blocking authority are independent fields. A high-confidence advisory does not become a block; a low-confidence kernel-integrity alarm may conservatively hold while deterministic integrity checks run.

definition_contract.name: AntiPatternDefinition
definition_contract.promotion_rule: Definitions learned from projects or AI remain proposed until independently validated for applicability, false-positive behavior and authority. Frequency alone cannot create a blocking rule.
definition_contract.version_rule: Changing trigger semantics, applicability, severity or blocking authority produces a new version and affected-world analysis; old findings retain their original definition reference.

reasoning: declared intent appears weakly connected to consequence
detector_architecture.reasoning_authority_rule: Model-based plausibility/nonsense detectors are advisory by default. They may request deterministic checks or human review but cannot block solely because a model judges a design unconventional or senseless.
temporal: repeated small edits causing cumulative rationalization debt
repeated downstream correction of upstream generator output

doctrine.actor_rule: The same guard contract applies to human, agent, solver, import, script, generator and external-machine proposals.
doctrine.compression_rule: AntiPattern is not a Plasma Kernel primitive. Definitions, findings, detectors, remedies and exceptions are domain/evaluation schemas represented using the existing seven primitives and governed transaction/evidence machinery.
doctrine.counter_principle: An anti-pattern is evidence, not prohibition. Non-standard states remain expressible when intentional, supportable and accepted under the relevant authority.
doctrine.distinction_rule: Unusual != wrong; rare != invalid; optimized != good; conventional != authoritative.
doctrine.foundation_principle: Evaluate proposed state transitions for known failure patterns, incoherence, pathological complexity and implausible consequences before they contaminate authoritative world state.

domain_registry.extensibility: Domain packs may add definitions/detectors without kernel changes if they conform to definition/finding/evidence/authority contracts.

cost: negligible design gain with large downstream cost
information_model: representation marked current against stale inputs

exception_contract.learning_rule: Accepted exceptions are not proof the anti-pattern was wrong; later outcomes may support, narrow or invalidate the definition.
exception_contract.name: ExceptionRecord
non_overridable: missing authority required by governing hard policy
exception_contract.separation_of_duties: For high-consequence findings, the producing AI/solver/tool cannot approve its own exception. Required human/independent authority is policy-defined.

finding_contract.immutability_rule: The original finding is immutable evidence. Disposition creates a linked record; it does not rewrite the detector output.
finding_contract.name: AntiPatternFinding
finding_contract.stale_rule: A finding cannot govern a different world/input revision by implication. Re-evaluate or mark stale/unknown.

loops.flow: PROPOSED TRANSFORM / WORK OUTPUT → PIN BASE REVISION + ACTOR/AUTHORITY → IMPACT CLOSURE → LOW-COST PREFLIGHT → {CORRUPT? BLOCK | OTHERWISE APPLY TO ISOLATED CANDIDATE} → CANDIDATE-WORLD EVALUATORS → INVARIANTS + ANTI-PATTERN FINDINGS + CHANGE-COHERENCE VECTOR → RESOLVE SEVERITY / CONFIDENCE / AUTHORITY → REMEDY / ALTERNATIVE / EXCEPTION / REJECT → COMMIT THROUGH PLS-KERNEL-01 OR LEAVE ACCEPTED WORLD UNCHANGED → TEMPORAL/PROJECT LEARNERS OBSERVE OUTCOME
loops.gap: Plasma can already reject hard invariant violations and show dependency-backed conflict previews, but it lacks a generalized immune system for operations that are technically expressible yet structurally corrupting, domain-pathological, nonsensical in context, temporally degenerative or disproportionately disruptive. Existing checks are fragmented across tools, rules, solvers and human expertise; AI agents could therefore generate locally valid but globally foolish states unless one governed evaluation contract spans all actors and scales.
loops.implementation_note: Implement PLS-16 first as a registry + evaluator result schema + transaction hook, not as an autonomous critic agent. Start with deterministic integrity checks and a few transparent domain detectors. Add model-based plausibility/nonsense detection only after severity/authority separation, revision pinning, exception semantics, false-positive feedback and novelty-protection tests are proven.

learned_practice_contract.example: Repeated RFIs/site modification around one jamb/material/supplier condition may propose an organization anti-pattern with applicability evidence and an alternate detail.
learned_practice_contract.outcome_feedback: Resolved findings, exceptions, downstream RFIs, cost deltas, fabrication changes, site deviations and as-built observations can update evidence for or against definitions.
learned_practice_contract.relationship_to_pls08: PLS-08 provides contextual evidence/practice learning; PLS-16 consumes validated recurrence as candidate anti-pattern knowledge.
safeguards: no automatic conversion to hard rule

loops.name: Pathology Guard + Anti-Pattern Intelligence
loops.next: Build a reference PLS-16 detector registry and transaction hook against four fixtures: (1) corrupt relation/topology operation blocked pre-apply, (2) RC-02 wall move with advisory versus hard findings clearly separated, (3) geodesic/fabrication fixture where near-identical panel types proliferate across multiple commits, and (4) low-value/high-disruption 40 mm kitchen/service move. Prove revision pinning, false-positive disposition, explicit exception, novelty protection, stale finding rejection and identical gating for a human action and an AI proposal.

performance_contract.gpu_cpu_rule: Geometry/topology clustering, similarity, spatial queries and large project statistics may compile to CPU/GPU representations, but detector meaning and authority remain semantic and inspectable.
performance_contract.incremental_rule: Cache revision-pinned detector inputs/results and invalidate by affected closure; never rescan the entire project on every edit unless a detector explicitly requires global scope.
performance_contract.interaction_budget: PLS-10 remains authoritative for pointer-loop responsiveness. Run only deterministic/local checks cheap enough for the hot path; defer deeper scans to release, idle, background or PLS-15 WorkItems.
performance_contract.unknown_rule: Performance limits may yield pending/unknown; they must not silently become pass.

scale_model.locality_rule: Run the cheapest sufficient detector at the smallest relevant scope first; expand only when dependencies, severity, uncertainty or scheduled background analysis justify it.
project_examples: 172 window types where a smaller family may satisfy intent
20 near-identical panels clustering around 3 manufacturing-significant families
circulation graph accumulating unnecessary dead ends
scale_model.temporal_window_rule: Temporal detectors declare event/revision windows, aggregation logic and resets; they cannot infer a trend from unbounded hidden history.

loops.summary: Detect corrupting operations, known domain anti-patterns, pathological complexity, low-value/high-disruption changes and implausible consequences as early as possible in the governed transaction lifecycle, without converting convention into law or suppressing architectural invention. PLS-16 evaluates proposed Transforms, isolated candidate worlds, event/history windows, systems and whole projects. Findings are evidence-bearing diagnostics; only kernel corruption, active hard Invariants or explicitly authorized blocking policy can stop publication absolutely.

ui_contract.example: Moving a wall 180 mm may show: +1 window type, +2 panel types, +1 structural transfer; closest lower-impact position +145 mm; Keep 180 mm remains available if no governing block applies.
ui_contract.local_projection: Prefer a small marker at the edited object/operation. On inspection show consequence, evidence/currentness, authority, affected scope and closest lower-impact alternatives.
ui_contract.no_dashboard_default: Do not require a persistent global issue dashboard for ordinary interaction; project/system patterns remain queryable in Inspect/Evaluation views and surface when materially relevant.
ui_contract.preserve_intent: When a hard conflict occurs, preserve the requested speculative state for comparison rather than snapping/clamping away the user intent.
ui_contract.principle: Quiet immune system, not warning-dialog hell.
